objectives.text: Hit the Host when he shows himself

objectives.name: the cubicles
objectives.text: Get up out of the lobby

objectives.name: the atrium
objectives.text: Get through the cubicle floor to the atrium

objectives.name: the server room
objectives.text: Up the atrium after the Host

objectives.name: the executive floor
objectives.text: Take the stairs to the executive floor

objectives.name: his office
objectives.text: Get to the Host's corner office

radio.line: Look at this. You've tracked mud all over my carpet.
That's Calder House. Radio people built it, back when radio was a job. He runs the show from in there.
Big treat tonight, folks. I'm coming down to say hello. In person! Don't wait up.
There he is! Huh. You're smaller in real life.
That's him. That's actually him. Don't chase him into anything stupid.
Ow! Ow. Okay. That's coming out of your fee.
Will somebody shoot him? I pay you people!
Back in five, folks. Don't touch that dial.
You were told to stay in the studio.
And you were told this'd be an easy contract, Commander. We've all been lied to.
His office is on this floor. Corner one. It's always the corner one.
Right. I'm leaving. Upstairs, everybody. And bring the wife.
He's going up. Echo's up there, Parker. She has to be.

headshot.line: Right in the face. In my own building. Unbelievable.
That's it. Keep your head down, he's above you.

bail.line: Ha! The cables. Everybody trips on the cables.
Ooh, the desk got him! Desk one, courier nil.
Up. He's watching from the balconies.
Slipped on a memo! Happens to the best of us.

combo.line: Do you have to do the flips indoors?
Good. Keep moving, don't let him set up.
Folks, he's doing parkour through middle management. I've wanted to do that for years.

kill.line: That was accounts. We needed accounts.
Who's gonna file all this now? You, Parker?
Good. Don't stop for the rest.
That's a Ward lad. Somebody tell the Commander. Quietly.

down.line: Up. He wants you on the floor. Don't give him that.
Courier down in the office! Somebody fetch a stapler. For the wound.
Up. Keep off the open floor.
He's down! I could shoot him from up here. I won't. Probably.

tape.line: ...he's got a whole floor of tapes up there. Every show. Even the ones where people stopped calling in.
...he rehearses in the mirror on the fourth floor. Out loud. Every line, even the 'spontaneous' ones.
...the Ward's man comes up the back stairs on Fridays. Never the lift. Doesn't trust the lift.
